scientific_question: Does a causal moving paired-expert chart represent future sparse-MoE residual writes substantially better than a frozen trajectory chart or an exact fixed BlockFHT coordinate image at the same four-coordinate layer budget?

anti_leakage.rule: Every heldout transition may use only transitions ending at or before its start state. The target transition and all future states are excluded from basis construction. Coordinates may be oracle-fitted on discovery activations only and are scored unchanged on heldout activations.

gauge.expert_identity: Within-run expert identities remain coupled to router rows; report router-fingerprint assignment but preserve the native identity unless an identity swap is stable on both activation splits.
gauge.hidden_identity: Sequentially match each c_fc row and its c_proj column as one GELU functional atom using discovery activations; require heldout assignment agreement before scoring.
gauge.scale: After matching, retain paired magnitudes because GELU is not positively homogeneous.

matched_coordinate_budget.scope: One coordinate jointly moves all eight experts, both matrices, and the router of a layer.
matched_coordinate_budget.basis_normalization: Parameter-space orthonormalization followed by the median norm of eligible historical layer chords.
matched_coordinate_budget.coordinate_fit: Ridge least squares against the exact discovery residual-output chord; use the identical coordinates on heldout activations.
matched_coordinate_budget.recovery: 1 - squared heldout residual-output error / squared exact heldout residual-output chord energy; do not clip negative values.

oracles.fixed_blockfht: Four joint directions generated by the production BlockFHT linear map from four canonical latent coordinates, with independent frozen seeds per router/c_fc/c_proj tensor and no learned basis.
oracles.static_paired_chart: Rank-four origin-through PCA of the eight normalized discovery parameter chords; freeze it at step 4752.
oracles.state_conditioned_paired_chart: At each heldout start state, orthonormalize the four most recent causally available paired layer chords. This moving frame is conditioned on the current trajectory state but never sees the target or future chord.

frozen_gates.authorization: Passing this seed-two oracle plus the seed-one assignment gate authorizes implementation and correctness testing of one compact moving paired-neuron decoder at 124M only. It does not authorize a larger rung or a dense learned basis.

interpretation.state_conditioned_pass: The direction problem is chart motion: a causal moving paired frame spans future residual writes, while fixed pseudo-random and frozen learned images do not.
interpretation.static_pass_without_state_margin: The trajectory is low-dimensional but does not justify state conditioning; use the simpler frozen paired chart.
interpretation.all_fail: MoE routing does not cure the direction bottleneck at four coordinates; increase structured coordinate budget only through a separately preregistered oracle, not a training sweep.
interpretation.fixed_blockfht_pass: BlockFHT is not the principal representational bottleneck at this budget; investigate optimization or coordinate prediction instead.
